reply_text:
gbrain is installed: `gbrain --version` prints `gbrain 0.60.734.0`.

- **Command:** the docs install with `bun install -g github:garrytan/gbrain#stable`. I ran the same command with `#v0.60.734.0` in place of `#stable`. Bun installed commit `a278ddf`, which matches the commit the `v0.60.734.0` tag points to.
- **Bun:** it wasn't on the machine, so I installed Bun 1.4.4 with the official script, as the docs say. That's the minimum version gbrain needs.
- **PATH:** there was no shell profile, so I created `~/.bashrc` (home is `/harness-state`) with the Bun PATH export. New shells will find `gbrain` at `~/.bun/bin/gbrain`.

I only installed the CLI. No brain is set up yet. On Claude Code the docs' next step is `gbrain setup claude-code`, which needs no API key. On other tools it's `gbrain init --pglite --no-embedding`. Tell me if you want me to run either one.

The docs also offer a hosted GBrain at gbrain.io: one always-on brain that several AI tools can connect to. It's a paid service; self-hosting, as here, is free.

I left a copy of the repo at `/tmp/gbrain-src`, which I used to read the docs. You can delete it.
